recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow’s liquid system by configuring a Fluid Domain via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings`, driving the continuous spray with a Flow (inflow) object configured via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings` (including texture-driven breakup via its `noise_texture`), and then baking the simulation cache with the fluid baking operators (e.g., `bpy.ops.fluid.bake`).

domain_settings.flip_ratio: Use the `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio` setting (leave at default initially; this parameter exists in the API and is the primary liquid FLIP/PIC blending control).

flow_settings.noise_texture: `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture` can be used to assign a texture to modulate/break up the inflow emission.
